sloka: स्थिरम् तु हृदयम् मन्ये मम इदम् यन् न दीर्यते ।प्रावृषि इव महा नद्याः स्पृष्टम् कूलम् नव अम्भसा ॥२-२०-४९॥
transliteration: sthiram tu hṛdayam manye mama idam yan na dīryate ।prāvṛṣi iva mahā nadyāḥ spṛṣṭam kūlam nava ambhasā ॥2-20-49॥

translations.english: I think my heart must be very firm (hard) like the bark of a great river which, touched by (a flood of) fresh water in the rainy season does not disintegrate.
